Z3 library version

Source: R/context.R
z3_version.Rd

Reports the version of the Z3 shared library z3r is running against.

Usage

z3_version()

z3_version_at_least(version)

Arguments

version

A version string such as "4.12.2".

Value

A list with elements runtime (the version of the loaded Z3 library, major.minor.build.revision), headers (the version of the Z3 headers z3r was compiled with) and full (Z3's full version string). z3r refuses to load if the two versions differ.

For z3_version_at_least(), TRUE when the Z3 headers z3r was compiled with are at least version, so that features needing that version are available.

Examples

z3_version()
#> $runtime
#> [1] "5.4.1.0"
#> 
#> $headers
#> [1] "5.4.1.0"
#> 
#> $full
#> [1] "5.4.1.0 145c0c51570a357cc558ce898ce77573ba9d4fbf 145c0c5"
#> 
z3_version_at_least("4.12.2")
#> [1] TRUE
